description: Create a new Status Page Announcement in OneUptime. Returns the created Status Page Announcement object with its ID. Use this to add new Status Page Announcements to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

description.description: Text of the announcement. This can be in Markdown format.

monitors.description: List of monitors affected by this announcement. If none are selected, all subscribers will be notified.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotified.description: Should subscribers be notified about this announcement?

showAnnouncementAt.description: When should this announcement be shown?

statusPages.description: Status Pages to show show this announcement on.

name: create_status_page_announcement
title: Create Status Page Announcement
